notes.title: Operating frequency
notes.body:
Data is 5 bytes (10-byte BCD), little-endian. Digit order: byte-1 low = 10 Hz, byte-1 high = 1 Hz, byte-2 low = 1 kHz, byte-2 high = 100 Hz, byte-3 low = 100 kHz, byte-3 high = 10 kHz, byte-4 low = 10 MHz, byte-4 high = 1 MHz, byte-5 low = 1 GHz (0 fixed), byte-5 high = 100 MHz (0-4 on IC-7100).

Commands 00 / 03 / 05 read or set transceive frequency; command 1C 03 reads the transmit frequency in Split.

notes.title: Operating mode
notes.body:
Data is 1-2 bytes.
Byte 1 - operating mode: 00=LSB, 01=USB, 02=AM, 03=CW, 04=RTTY, 05=FM, 06=WFM, 07=CW-R, 08=RTTY-R.
Byte 2 - filter: 01=FIL1, 02=FIL2, 03=FIL3 (optional with commands 01 and 06).
